newsitem.title: UK: Prudential largest UK-based fund manager - Citywatch.
newsitem.headline: Prudential largest UK-based fund manager - Citywatch.

text.p: Prudential Corp is the largest UK-based institutional investor with some 91 billion sterling under management, according to a study by research group Citywatch.
It said the Pru was closely followed by Schroders Plc at 88 billion and Mercury Asset Management (MAM) at 86 billion.

The figures were contained in Citywatch's Institutional Investor Yearbook, and showed that the top ten institutional investors in FTSE 100 companies control some 22.2 percent of the index, with MAM alone accounting for 4.2 percent.
It said MAM was the country's largest fund manager in UK equities with 41 billion sterling under management, followed by Prudential at 32 billion and Schroders at 29 billion.
MAM was also the UK's largest segregated pension fund manager at 50 billion, followed by PDFM at 48 billion and Schroders at 43 billion.
Scottish Widows, Legal & General, and Sun Life of Canada were the top three pooled pension fund managers by assets under management, and Henderson, Fleming and 3i the top investment trust managers.
Schroders led the unit trust management table at 15 billion, with M&G second at 10.3 billion and Hill Samuel at 7.2 billion.
The survey covered 209 institutions managing an aggregate 1.8 trillion sterling of assets, of which 764 billion was in UK equities.
